description: The first free, scriptable, agent-native CLI for Bahrain's commercial registry — with a local store, ownership-graph traversal, and change-diffing no other tool has.

novel_features.name: CR watch + diff
novel_features.description: Detect exactly what changed on a company (shareholders, signatories, capital, status, address) since you last checked.

novel_features.name: Ownership graph
novel_features.description: Traverse the partner -> company -> partner network around a CR to surface direct and indirect links.

novel_features.name: Who-controls (person portfolio)
novel_features.description: List every company a person is a partner, signatory, or director of, with their role and share count.

novel_features.name: Portfolio change feed
novel_features.description: One agent-pollable stream of every change across all watched companies since the last sync.

novel_features.name: Expiry / renewal alerts
novel_features.description: List watched companies whose CR expires within a window, flagging any that quietly went EXPIRED or CANCELLED.

novel_features.name: Market segment analytics
novel_features.description: Aggregate the synced corpus by status, company type, nationality, sector, or registration year.
